''The Wonderful Wizard of Oz'' is a novel written by L. Frank Baum later adapted into a Broadway musical, a film and a text variation initially originated from Russian A.Volkov's translation called ''The Wizard of the Emerald City series''.

The book is in the public domain and this is why Lojbanist [[User:Selpa'i|la selpa'i]] translated it to Lojban in 2013. You can read the translation [[lo se manci te makfa pe la .oz.|here]].
